N24.idea: domino: three spinners in a row turn each other as they leave - the order of departures decides every direction

N25.idea: silent gate: the spinner beside the gate must leave through it unturned - any neighbour leaving first turns it into a deadlock

N26.idea: pull into parity: a magnet pulls an alternating spinner into a three-neighbour slot - the parity of turns after the pull decides its exit

N27.idea: pull away: a magnet pulls a spinner out of a neighbourhood whose departures would turn it the wrong way

N28.idea: advances on a rhythm: two Sequence blocks advance next to a pattern spinner - each advance moves its cw-cw-ccw cycle on

N29.idea: alternating chain: two adjacent alternating spinners turn each other back and forth

N30.idea: parity key: the only purple key is an alternating spinner; it must leave after the right parity of turns to unlock
